findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a rollback AC that asserts the POST-ROLLBACK interpreted state: after reverting to pre-A4-2 code, a persisted key-set prev_snapshot.json ({jira_key:{}}) is read WITHOUT silent field-arbitration regressions (or state the recovery step — e.g. delete-then-cap-0/no-write re-fetch pass proving zero inbound creates — and attach a literal `DATA LOSS RISK: departed field values are unrecoverable once narrowed` note).
evidence: Plan: 'The G1 corpus diff ran forward only. Before merging, run it backward (key-set -> full, the revert direction) and record the result.' — but 'backward' here is the same NEW differ over a key-set input, not OLD code reading the new artifact.
T11 POST-ROLLBACK-STATE trigger: this change (c) narrows a read path and (d) is a one-way transformation with residual data (empty field blobs) that a reverted OLD reader interprets differently.
reconcile.py:615 `shutil.copy2(curr_path, prev_path)` is the cutover write that must be narrowed; once written, the departed full field values are gone.
outbound_fields.py:265-266 `_local_matches_prev`: `if not prev_jira_fields: return False` — OLD-code fallback path silently degrades to local-wins on empty entries.
findings.finding: The mandatory rollback artifact validates only the key-set->full corpus diff under the NEW differ code; it does not assert the interpreted state after a CODE rollback in which OLD code reads a persisted key-set prev_snapshot ({jira_key:{}}). The narrowing is a one-way transformation of persisted field data (departed field values are unrecoverable once a key-set prev is written), so a back-out can report success while leaving OLD readers silently mis-interpreting empty field blobs (field-arbitration degrades to local-wins; comment-dedup/inbound paths see empty prev).
findings.location: Rollback (mandatory artifact) section; AC line 'The reverse-direction diff (key-set -> full) is recorded on this ticket as the rollback artifact'
scenarios: Deploy A4-2, run one pass (prev becomes key-set), then git-revert the code but leave the persisted key-set prev_snapshot.json in place; OLD field-arbitration and bridge_fsck now read empty field values and behave differently with no signal.
A push-retry stash-pop or a mixed-version GHA run where an OLD reconciler reads a NEW key-set prev.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the rollback artifact to run the OLD (pre-A4-2) reconciler read path against a NEW key-set prev over the >=4 corpus pairs and record the delta, and specify that a code rollback must be paired with the documented prev-regeneration path (delete + cap-0/no-write re-fetch pass proving zero inbound creates) since the narrowing is one-way.
